# Test fixture source

`portrait.jpg` — Albert Einstein, photographed by Ferdinand Schmutzer
in Vienna, 1921.

- Downloaded from Wikimedia Commons:
  https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3e/Einstein_1921_by_F_Schmutzer_-_restoration.jpg
  (Commons file: "Einstein 1921 by F Schmutzer - restoration.jpg")
- Licence: **public domain** — photograph published in 1921; the
  photographer died in 1932.
- Downloaded 18 Nov 2026 and downscaled to 390×512 px. Used ONLY as a
  face-detection test fixture (the same image compared with itself);
  it is not project data and implies no accuracy claim.
